title: Handling Bug Reports
steps: Confirm the affected feature, platform, and steps to reproduce; ask for screenshots if missing.
Check past tickets for the same issue and link duplicates.
If the bug blocks core functionality for an Enterprise customer or affects multiple customers, escalate per POL-ESC-003.
Otherwise, file an engineering ticket with severity matching the urgency and give the customer the ticket ID.
Consider service credits per POL-CREDIT-007 for prolonged outages.

title: Handling Billing Issues
steps: Verify the charge(s) against the customer's order history.
For duplicate or erroneous charges, issue a refund per POL-REFUND-001; no approval needed unless above 500 USD.
For pricing disputes, explain the price change and reference the plan terms; offer a callback if unresolved.
Confirm the refund amount and expected processing time (5-10 business days) to the customer.

title: Handling Feature Requests
steps: Thank the customer and restate the use case to confirm understanding.
Log the request on the product feedback board per POL-FEATURE-008.
Suggest existing workarounds if any exist.
Do not promise timelines.

title: Handling Account Access Problems
steps: Verify identity before making any account changes.
Walk through password reset / SSO troubleshooting.
If account compromise is suspected, escalate to Security per POL-ESC-003.

title: Handling Churn Risk
steps: Identify the root cause of dissatisfaction (open tickets, pricing, missing features).
Resolve or expedite any open tickets; escalate to CS Lead if two or more are unresolved beyond 14 days.
If eligible, present a retention offer per POL-RETENTION-005.
Notify the account manager for Enterprise customers within 1 business day.

title: Handling Abusive or Policy-Violating Messages
steps: Do not mirror tone; stay factual and courteous.
Separate the underlying issue from the abusive language and still triage the issue.
Send at most one conduct reminder per POL-ABUSE-004.
If there is a threat of violence or doxxing, pause the conversation and escalate to Security immediately.

title: Handling Positive Feedback
steps: Thank the customer personally.
Log the feedback for the product/marketing team; ask permission before using it as a testimonial.
No further action required.

title: General / Unclear Feedback Triage
steps: If the feedback is too vague to act on, reply asking one specific clarifying question.
Route to a human triager if the category is still unclear after clarification.
Log the feedback for trend analysis.
